metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IQODIF crystallizes in the tetragonal crystal system with space group P 4/n m m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C64 H114 Co24 Eu8 N64 O58 S32 6+,6(Br1 1-),4(C1 H4 O1),3(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu1A (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Co1 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co2 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co3 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co4 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co5 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co6 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Co7 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co8 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co9 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co10 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co11 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co12 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Co13 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co14 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co15 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co16 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co17 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co18 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Co19 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co20 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co21 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co22 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Co23 (Co) has 5 O neighbors; Co24 (Co) has 3 O neighbors; Eu9 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu10 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu11 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu12 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu13 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu14 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu15 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu16 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 132 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.331-4.345 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 3.32-145.51°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Co24Eu8(OH)18(mmt)16(N3)8(NO3)8(CH3O)16]·6Br·4CH3OH·3H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 18 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 8 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
